messages.content: 四個圓的總周長是多少，其中第一個圓的半徑為5公分，第二個圓的半徑為10公分，第三個圓的半徑為15公分，第四個圓的半徑為20公分？

function.name: calculate_circumference
function.description: Calculates the circumference of a circle with a given radius. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

radius.description: The radius of the circle in the unit given.

message.content:
四個圓的總周長為：

\[
\begin{aligned}
C_1 &= 2\pi \times 5 = 10\pi \\
C_2 &= 2\pi \times 10 = 20\pi \\
C_3 &= 2\pi \times 15 = 30\pi \\
C_4 &= 2\pi \times 20 = 40\pi \\
\end{aligned}
\]

總和：

\[
C_{\text{總}} = (10+20+30+40)\pi = 100\pi \approx 314.16\ \text{公分}
\]

所以四個圓的總周長大約是 **314.16 公分**。

C1 = 2π*5 = 10π ≈ 31.41592653589793
C2 = 2π*10 = 20π ≈ 62.83185307179586
C3 = 2π*15 = 30π ≈ 94.24777960769379
C4 = 2π*20 = 40π ≈ 125.66370614359172

Sum = (10+20+30+40)π = 100π ≈ 314.1592653589793 cm.
